title: Shopper Pay Schedule — Cartwise Shopper Batches Base Rates and Pay Floors
content:
The fixed and count-based pay rates of Cartwise Shopper Batches, and the floor on each batch's pay before tips, are set per batch type as follows (all amounts in USD).

| Batch type | Base pay per batch | Pay per additional order (each order beyond the first) | Pay per item unit shopped | Staging pay per staged order | Minimum batch pay before tips | Pay shown on the accepted offer guaranteed as a floor |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Shop-Only Batch | 6.00 | 0.00 | 0.20 | 1.00 | 7.00 | Yes |
| Express 30 Batch | 8.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 10.00 | Yes |
| Single Delivery Batch | 7.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 8.00 | Yes |
| Double Delivery Batch | 7.00 | 3.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 11.00 | Yes |
| Triple Delivery Batch | 7.00 | 3.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 14.00 | Yes |
| Stock-Up Batch | 12.00 | 0.00 | 0.05 | 0.00 | 20.00 | Yes |

**Rounding.** For every batch type, every computed pay component is rounded to the cent, half up.

## Notes on the schedule

- **Base pay** is the fixed pay for completing the batch.
- **Pay per additional order** is paid for each order the batch carries beyond the first; only the Double Delivery Batch and the Triple Delivery Batch carry a rate above zero (3.00).
- **Pay per item unit** is multiplied by the item units in the batch; the Shop-Only Batch pays 0.20 per unit and the Stock-Up Batch 0.05 per unit.
- **Staging pay** is paid per order staged for pickup or handoff; only the Shop-Only Batch carries it (1.00).
- **Minimum batch pay** is a floor on the batch's pay before tips: where the components come to less, a top-up is added to reach it. Tips never count toward it.
- **Shown pay as a floor** means the pay before tips shown on the accepted offer is guaranteed unless the orders changed after acceptance.

## Worked illustration (hypothetical batch)

A hypothetical Triple Delivery Batch carrying 3 orders earns base pay of 7.00 and pay for two additional orders of 3.00 each, 6.00 in all, so 13.00 from these two components. Its minimum batch pay before tips is 14.00, so if no other component were posted the batch would be 1.00 short of its floor.
